title: Aurora reserve policy
text: Aurora Fund keeps 18 percent of assets in its liquidity reserve. The reserve is reviewed on the first business day of each month.

title: Birch bond profile
text: Birch Municipal Bond has a modified duration of 4.2 years. Its coupon is paid twice per year.

title: Cobalt receivables
text: Cobalt Services issues invoices on net-30 terms. An invoice becomes overdue on day 31.

title: Delta concentration limit
text: Delta Portfolio limits exposure to any single issuer to 12 percent of net assets. Cash is excluded from that issuer limit.

title: Ember equipment loan
text: Ember Manufacturing's equipment loan has a fixed annual rate of 6.25 percent and matures in June 2031.

title: Fjord currency hedge
text: Fjord Export hedges 70 percent of forecast euro receipts. The hedge horizon is six months.

title: Grove cash runway
text: Grove Analytics reports 14 months of cash runway at the approved operating plan. The estimate is refreshed quarterly.

title: Harbor budget escalation
text: Harbor Division escalates a monthly budget variance when it exceeds 5 percent. The finance director owns the review.

title: Ibis audit schedule
text: Ibis Holdings closes its internal audit ledger every quarter. Evidence is retained for five years.

title: Juniper dividend calendar
text: Juniper Cooperative declares dividends in March and September. Payments occur ten business days after declaration.

title: Kite capital requests
text: Kite Labs requires two approvals for capital requests above 250000 dollars. One approver must be from finance.

title: Linden property coverage
text: Linden Group reviews property coverage each January. The current deductible is 50000 dollars.
